heading.escrow: All set! Your task with {name} has started.

lead.unknown: Sign in with the account you used for the purchase so we can check it. We only confirm after we see it in your account.
lead.checking: Just a moment, we're checking your account.
lead.escrow: Your payment is held safely and only goes to the creator when you approve each milestone. Connect the solver to your AI so it can start working on the task.
lead.license: Your permanent license is already in your account. All that's left is connecting the solver to your AI. It takes about 5 minutes and we'll guide you through every step.

missing.title: We can't find this purchase in your account yet
missing.body: If you just paid, it may take a few more moments to show up. If you signed in with a different account, check the one you used for the purchase.

unknown.title: Sign in to check your purchase
unknown.body: This page only confirms the purchase after it sees it in your account.

ticket.taskLine: Task with guarantee · {n, plural, one {# milestone} other {# milestones}}
ticket.viaPix: Paid by Pix: Solvers completed the purchase on the network for you.

done.review: After using {name}, review it from your library.

failed.title: This purchase didn't go through
failed.body: It wasn't recorded on the network, and nothing was taken from your wallet.
failed.refund: Solvers couldn't complete it, so your Pix is being refunded.

setup.title: Connect {name} to your AI
setup.leadAgent: It takes four quick steps. You only do this once.
setup.leadGeneric: It takes four quick steps. You only do this once: the same connector works for every solver you have.
setup.trial: {n, plural, one {You have # free use to try it out} other {You have # free uses to try it out}}

step1.title: Copy the connector address
step1.body: It's a single address for all solvers. Once your AI connects, you sign in with your Solvers account and it starts using what you bought.
step1.unavailable: Couldn't load the address. Reload the page.

step2.bodyClaude: In Claude, open Settings, go to Connectors and choose Add custom connector.
step2.bodyGpt: In ChatGPT, open Settings and go to Apps & Connectors (if you don't see it, turn on Developer mode under Advanced settings). Choose Create to add a custom connector.

step3.title: Paste the address and confirm
step3.body: Paste the address you copied in step 1 and confirm. Your AI will open a Solvers page asking for your authorization: sign in with the same account you use here.

step4.title: Run a test
step4.body: Open a new conversation and ask for something simple. If your AI answers mentioning the solver, it worked.
step4.promptAgent: “Use {name} and tell me how it can help me.”
